note: Lakeport State Park's north modern campground, in woods along the Lake Huron shoreline 10 mi north of Port Huron (campground entrance 7605 Lakeshore Road); paved and grass pads. The park's day-use area with the buoyed swim beach is about a mile south, across the village of Lakeport. The separate South campground (56 sites, not on the lake) is its own entry. --Claude
summary: DNR park page + booking site + DNR rates table, verified for the North campground alone: 194 sites (confirmed), pull-throughs (confirmed), to 40 ft (new), 30/50-amp electric only (electric 50 confirmed, water/sewer false new), two toilet/shower buildings + sanitation station (showers confirmed, flush/dump new), reservable on MiDNRReservations (platform confirmed), reservation season May 1 - Oct 21 (confirmed). Fees 41-46 (2026 table) -> 43-48 (2027 booking site). Season not stated (only day-use dates and the reservation season). Phone 810-327-6224 matches. Pin sits in the northern wooded part of the campground tract north of the South entry's pin; sites are not visible under the canopy. Note trimmed of field restatements.
